# Cub Scout Program

## Advancement

Cub Scout activities are centered around earning  badges that are specific to
each school grade level.  This badge represents a rank.  Advancement refers to
the progress a Cub Scout makes toward their badge of rank.  All of the
activities for each rank are in the Cub Scout handbooks.

[ Learn About the Advancement Trail ](https://www.scouting.org/programs/cub-
scouts/what-cub-scouts-earn/the-advancement-trail/)

## Adventures

Based on different topics such as hiking, nature, science, citizenship, first
aid, sports, and more, adventures are earned as a Cub Scout advances toward
their badge of rank.  Once an adventure is completed, a Cub Scout receives
recognition in the form of an adventure loop or adventure pin.

[ Learn About Cub Scouting Adventures ](https://www.scouting.org/programs/cub-
scouts/what-cub-scouts-earn/cub-scouting-adventures/)

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2018/07/th-150x150.jpeg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20150%20150%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

###### Kindergarten through third grade; Lions, Tigers, Wolves, and Bears earn
metal adventure loops (shown above).  These are designed to slide onto a Cub
Scout’s belt.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Adventure-Colors-
small.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20200%20537%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

###### Fourth and fifth grade, Webelos and Arrow of Light, earn metal
adventure pins.  These pins are placed on the Adventure Colors (shown above)

## Special Recognition

There are some special recognitions Cub Scouts can earn.

[ Learn About Special Recognition ](https://www.scouting.org/programs/cub-
scouts/what-cub-scouts-earn/other-youth-awards/)

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/youth-religious-
award-300x143.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20300%20143%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

 In partnership with dozens of faith organizations representing different
religions, youth may earn the Religious Emblem of their faith.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/recruiter-
strip-300x95.png)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20300%2095%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

The recruiter patch is awarded to Cub Scouts who bring other youth into
Scouting.

## Youth Uniforms

The uniform is one of the methods of delivering the Scouting program.  In
addition to creating a sense of belonging, the uniform gives a Scout the
ability to display their personal achievements.

[ Learn About the Cub Scout Uniform ](https://www.scouting.org/programs/cub-
scouts/cub-scout-uniform/)

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/06/Tiger_Banner3-300x300.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20300%20300%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Adult Awards

There are various awards for those who serve as Scout volunteer leaders.  Some
have specific requirements and are earned, while others are awarded for
exceptional service.  At right are two examples of the many adult awards that
are available.

[ Learn About Adult Awards ](https://www.scouting.org/programs/cub-
scouts/what-cub-scouts-earn/adult-awards-and-recognition/)

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/Den-
Leader-300x136.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20300%20136%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

The Den Leader Award is a symbol of quality leadership.  

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/william-d-
boyce-300x132.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20300%20132%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

The William D. Boyce award is presented to those who start a new Pack, Troop,
Crew, or Ship.

## Adult Uniforms

The uniform is one of the methods of delivering the Scouting program. Adults
who serve youth directly should always be in full uniform to set a good
example and to show that they, too, are part of the den and pack.

[ Learn About Adult Uniforms ](https://www.scouting.org/programs/cub-
scouts/what-cub-scouts-earn/cub-scout-adult-leader-uniform/)
